items.original_title: FinancialJuice: Stocks Pause After Surge as Earnings, Hormuz Hopes in Focus – US Market Wrap

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: Stocks Pause After Surge as Earnings, Hormuz Hopes in Focus – US Market Wrap
evidence.snippet: Wall Street’s blistering rally took a breather as traders digested recent gains alongside a wave of corporate earnings and optimism around a reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. After a run that added $3.7 trillion to the S&P 500’s market value, the index edged lower, with most megacaps declining even as Nvidia rose. Despite strong results, SpaceX tumbled 14% as $101 billion in shares became eligible for trading Thursday. US crude slipped to around $75. Iran said it reached an agreement with Oman on a proposed shipping route through Hormuz, marking a potential step toward reopening the key energy corridor. On the economic front, US services activity expanded at a steady pace in July, though rising input costs continued to pressure businesses. Hiring slowed, with firms adding fewer jobs than expected, pointing to some cooling in labor demand. If confirmed in Friday’s jobs report, the trend could allow Federal Reserve officials to maintain focus on still-elevated inflation. Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari told CNBC the central bank should begin gradually raising rates to bring price pressures under control.

items.original_title: FinancialJuice: Bank of America NFP Preview

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: Bank of America NFP Preview
evidence.snippet: We expect July payrolls to rise by a below-consensus but still solid 80,000, with private payrolls increasing by 95,000. Benign claims data and steady labour-market indicators point to continued job growth, though summer distortions, softer ADP data and a possible reversal in local government hiring create some downside risk. The unemployment rate is expected to rise to 4.3% as participation rebounds, although strong household employment could keep it at 4.2%. A report in line with these forecasts would suggest that labour-market downside risks have largely faded and support the case for three further rate hikes this year.

items.original_title: FinancialJuice: Credit Agricole FX Overview: Investors Remain Risk-Seeking While Waiting for a US-Iran Deal

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: Credit Agricole FX Overview: Investors Remain Risk-Seeking While Waiting for a US-Iran Deal
evidence.snippet: The Risk Index remains deep in risk-seeking territory despite a modest increase over the past week. Investors entered the weekend concerned about renewed US-Iran escalation, but Trump called off large-scale attacks and, alongside Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, returned to talking up the possibility of a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Bessent said an agreement could come within days, while Trump said talks were progressing but continued to threaten military action if Iran does not agree. Middle East developments are therefore likely to remain the main near-term driver of sentiment. Mixed US technology earnings have not materially damaged risk appetite, while lower equity volatility, softer US data, lower oil prices and falling Treasury yields have provided support. The largest source of increased risk has been higher FX volatility following joint US-Japan intervention to support the yen, alongside wider emerging-market sovereign spreads and higher gold prices. Investors will now focus on US ISM services and payrolls data for further evidence that growth is slowing.

items.original_title: FinancialJuice: Credit Agricole: Premature BoJ Hikes Could Worsen Future Yen Weakness

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: Credit Agricole: Premature BoJ Hikes Could Worsen Future Yen Weakness
evidence.snippet: Japan’s government has increasingly framed the BoJ’s role as a dual mandate: supporting strong economic growth while maintaining stable inflation. The aim is to establish real growth above 1% and nominal growth above 3% alongside the 2% inflation target. However, this dual mandate does not yet appear fully embedded within the BoJ, where the older focus on price stability alone still seems influential. A premature rate hike could derail the investment cycle, weaken future supply capacity and ultimately increase the risk of stronger yen depreciation and inflation. Simply accelerating rate hikes would not solve the underlying problem. Sustained yen strength is more likely only once strategic investment gains sufficient momentum. Raising rates while investment remains weak risks delivering a weaker economy and greater pressure on households, while government-BoJ coordination on objectives is normal economic policy rather than a threat to central bank independence.

evidence.snippet: The yen has weakened modestly during the Asian trading session resulting in USD/JPY rising back up to within touching distance of the 200-day moving average at aroundl58.00 after hitting a low yesterday at 157.18. The yen has strengthened sharply since late last week on the back of joint intervention by Japan and the US. It has been estimated that Japan likely purchased around USD 34 billion of yen on Friday on top of around USD 53 billion on Thursday. It would be a record amount of intervention by Japan if confirmed at the end of this month. In comparison, it has been reported that the US may have purchased between USD 5-10 of yen on Friday according to a picture of US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's notepad although that estimate is much more speculative. Looking back at previous periods of US intervention, the actual amount could have been even smaller for example in March 2011 the US sold only USD1 billion of yen alongside Japan and other G7 countries. The importance of US taking part is more symbolic with the scale of yen purchases likely to remain much smaller than those undertaken by Japan with the aim more to send a stronger deterrent to speculative yen sellers. At the same time, the announcement that Japan plans to use the Fed's FIMA repo facility to acquire US dollars without having to sell down more of its holdings of US securities has helped to ease selling pressure in the Treasury market as well. Even the threat of further joint intervention could also help to reduce the need for further intervention and thereby need for further sales of US securities. However, the credibility of the threat is likely to be questioned by market participants given doubts over how much the US is willing and able to intervene to support the yen. evidence.snippet: 트럼프 “상대 측 협상 요청해 와… 호르무즈 해협 합의 다가와” [공부의여신 네트워크] 도널드 J. 트럼프 대통령은 호르무즈 해협 상황과 관련해 상대측에서 먼저 연락을 취해와 협상이 진행 중이며, 조만간 타결될 가능성이 있다고 밝혔다. 트럼프 대통령은 취재진과의 만남에서 "그들이 나에게 연락해 이야기를 나누자고 요청했다"며 "그들은 타격을 받는 것을 원치 않으며, 거래를 하는 것이 매우 명민한 선택이 될 것"이라고 말했다. 이어 "협상이 매우 잘 진행되었으며 48시간 내에 윤곽이 드러날 것"이라고 덧붙였다. 지닌 피로 연방검사의 반추위 사건 기소 취하 논란 언급 트럼프 대통령은 최근 링컨 기념관 반사못 파손 사건의 기소를 취하한 지닌 피로 워싱턴 D.C. 연방검사 관련 질문에 "그녀의 결정은 완전히 틀렸다"며 강하게 비판했다. 트럼프 대통령은 "부실 공사가 아닌 명백한 기물 파손이었으며, 현장을 본 목격자도 존재한다"고 강조하며, 피로 검사에게 불만을 전달했다고 밝혔다. 직위 유지 여부에 대해서는 "아직 결정하지 않았다"며 여지를 남겼다. 맥스 밀러 의원 가정폭력 의혹 관련 언급 한편, 최근 가정폭력 의혹으로 하원 윤리위원회 조사를 받게 된 맥스 밀러(Max Miller) 하원의원에 대해서는 "그가 문제를 잘 해결해 나가기를 바란다"며 안타까운 심경을 내비쳤다. 미국 경제 성과 및 민주당 비판 미국 경제 상황과 관련해서는 "주식 시장이 연일 신고가를 경신하고 있으며, 무역 지표와 경제 지표 모두 이전에 없던 뛰어난 수치를 기록하고 있다"며 "미국으로의 투자 규모 역시 상상 이상"이라고 평가했다. 반면 민주당 내 진보·사회주의 성향 후보들의 선전에 대해서는 "민주당은 극심한 혼란에 빠져 있다"며 "차라리 '미국 공산당'이라는 신당을 창당하는 편이 나을 것"이라고 지적했다.
